name: 79901 · El Paso, TX
findings: ZIP 79901 (El Paso) has 88 nonprofit organizations. 37 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 34 organizations.
Youth organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 79901 (El Paso) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
38% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 79901 (El Paso) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 27.1 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 34 organizations here; 49% of all organizations here have no identified type.
